items.title_en: Uber CEO says he expects employees to respond to emails on weekends: ‘Don’t come here if you want to coast’
items.title_zh: Uber首席执行官表示，他希望员工在周末回复电子邮件：“如果你想溜达，就不要来这里”
items.summary_en: In an interview, CEO Dara Khosrowshahi described Uber’s workplace culture as demanding and said employees are expected to take their responsibilities seriously.
items.summary_zh: 在接受采访时，首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西 (Dara Khosrowshahi) 形容 Uber 的工作场所文化要求很高，并表示员工应该认真对待自己的责任。

items.title_en: ‘They call us 7-Eleven’: Indian man on racist attack during Las Vegas trip
items.title_zh: “他们叫我们7-11”：印度男子在拉斯维加斯之旅中遭受种族主义袭击
items.summary_en: Paramvir Singh Beniwal documented the encounter on YouTube during his Las Vegas trip.
items.summary_zh: 帕拉姆维尔·辛格·贝尼瓦尔 (Paramvir Singh Beniwal) 在拉斯维加斯之旅期间在 YouTube 上记录了这次遭遇。

items.title_en: ‘Where will they go?’ Bengaluru elephant attack sparks concerns over habitat loss
items.title_zh: “它们会去哪里？”班加罗尔大象袭击引发对栖息地丧失的担忧
items.summary_en: Forest officials said this was the first time an elephant had come into conflict with humans so close to the city.
items.summary_zh: 森林官员表示，这是大象第一次在如此靠近城市的地方与人类发生冲突。

items.title_en: Why Chinese trader thinks Indian clients are ‘hard’ to work with
items.title_zh: 为什么中国贸易商认为印度客户“很难”合作
items.summary_en: Chinese electronics trader Jay Chen’s comments about Indian clients, price negotiations and scams have sparked a debate on social media.
items.summary_zh: 中国电子产品贸易商杰伊·陈有关印度客户、价格谈判和诈骗的言论在社交媒体上引发了争论。

items.title_en: How this 78-year-old gamer became the oldest woman Fortnite streamer
items.title_zh: 这位 78 岁的玩家如何成为最年长的《堡垒之夜》女性主播
items.summary_en: Cath Bowie, 78, has become the oldest woman Fortnite streamer on Twitch, attracting more than 24,000 followers.
items.summary_zh: 78 岁的 Cath Bowie 成为 Twitch 上最年长的《堡垒之夜》女性主播，吸引了超过 24,000 名粉丝。
